name: TC-DA — Student views unsubmitted Direct Apply application in Cialfo-initiated revision state

steps.name: Log in as the student and open Direct Apply home
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Direct Apply', exact: true }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'What is Direct Apply?', exact: true }))
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Direct Apply', exact: true }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'What is Direct Apply?', exact: true }))
Verify the Revision requested badge and Revise Application CTA are shown
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('tbody tr').filter({ hasText: 'Christian Heritage College' })
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('tbody tr').filter({ hasText: 'Christian Heritage College' }).getByText('Revision requested', { exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" locator('tbody tr').filter({ hasText: 'Christian Heritage College' }).getByText('Revise Application', { exact: true })
Click locator('tbody tr').filter({ hasText: 'Christian Heritage College' }).getByText('Revise Application', { exact: true })
Verify the DA application form opens in revision mode
